references.text: Concerns righteous judgment and not doing wrong in judgment, the same theme of justice in legal decisions
Repeats the principle of fair judgment without regard for persons, as Moses instructed the judges
Links obedience to God's commands with living in and taking possession of the land, the same promise of inheriting the land
Do what is right and good in the Lord's sight to take possession of the good land, parallel to the promise of inheriting the land
Call to learn to do good, seek justice, and help the oppressed, the same call to righteousness
Amos' call for justice to roll down like water and righteousness like a never-failing stream
Micah explains what the Lord requires: to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with God
Jesus' blessing on those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, they shall be filled
Jesus' exhortation to seek first God's kingdom and his righteousness, parallel to pursuing righteousness
Paul discusses the Gentiles' attainment of righteousness and Israel's pursuit of the law of righteousness
Paul exhorts Timothy to pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, endurance, and gentleness
Call to flee youthful passions and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace
